نتراشق (form VI)
# نَتَرَاشَقُ (natarāšaqu) /na.ta.raː.ʃa.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# نُتَرَاشَقُ (nutarāšaqu) /nu.ta.raː.ʃa.qu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# نَتَرَاشَقَ (natarāšaqa) /na.ta.raː.ʃa.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَرَاشَقَ (tarāšaqa)
# نُتَرَاشَقَ (nutarāšaqa) /nu
